description: handle_email_import (line 1696-1699) uses args.get("emails").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) (borrow) then .clone() on the resulting map reference. The function takes args: Value by ownership and could use args.remove("emails") to take ownership of the map directly, avoiding the full Map clone. Same pattern as JMAP-4ii.68 (email_set update loop).
title: email_import: args.get("emails") borrow forces Map clone
